title: THE BODY CULTURE CONVERSATION
description: After training, a few adult students stay in the recovery lounge, where the conversation turns to physiques, proportions, confidence and the strange importance people attach to measurements. Dan Roman takes the teasing in good humour, while Noah admits that he has spent too much time comparing himself with other men. The group is frank without turning anyone into a public score; each man decides what he is comfortable sharing. By the time they leave, the talk has become less about numbers and more about knowing one's own body.
